CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2580 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8. Bus nonce: e36fe01aeff76af88d3516d1dc44fc52. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8` or `Fix review: blocked 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: e36fe01aeff76af88d3516d1dc44fc52`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2580 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2580-e36fe01a`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW of PR #2580 (group R10-FLOW-RELAY-HOLD, branch fix/r10-flow-relay-hold) at moved head 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8. The previous verdict was MERGE at caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0 (`git fetch origin review/2580; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`). Since then the fixer absorbed main twice, the last time main 8a4c438e (merge commit 808137a9 with parent 8aec4677), resolving a content conflict with #2578 in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Scope: what changed since caac2c8d. `git diff caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8` minus main's own changes (compare with `git diff caac2c8d^1..8a4c438e` / three-dot against merge bases). Name anything beyond the absorb resolution and the body.
- Judge the mutants-file resolution. It must be the union: main's S38 and #2578's body_patch-1, plus the PR's cloud_relay-1..11, tick_loop-1..2 and heartbeat-1..4. No side's mutant may be dropped: compare `git show 8a4c438e:<file>`, `git show 8aec4677:<file>` and the head. The INSTRUMENTS.md change must be +9/-0 against main.
- Re-run the mutation harness over the PR's mutants (the body claims 60 KILLED, survivors=0, M0 0 red) and the self-tests (cloud_relay 189/0, wiring 77/77), each with a null control. Re-measure every figure in the body.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8` must be clean (main is now 0b162da1). Read check-runs at this head: a red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" or "API is unreachable" is external.
- carry_audit.py check over the body must give 0 unrouted. Every Carry names a live group on main's roster.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: e36fe01aeff76af88d3516d1dc44fc52. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
